import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.api import handle_add
c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
assert handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}) == {"ok": True}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Alice")]

from src.api import handle_import
r = handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": " A@B ", "name": " Al "}, {"email": "X@y.z", "name": "X"}]})
assert r == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}, r
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Al"), ("x@y.z", "X")]
for bad in ([{"email": "p@q", "name": "P"}, {"email": "P@Q", "name": "P2"}],
            [{"email": "p@q", "name": "P"}, {"email": "bad", "name": "n"}],
            [{"email": "p@q", "name": "P"}, {"email": "r@s", "name": "n", "x": 1}],
            [{"email": "p@q", "name": "P"}, "row"]):
    try:
        handle_import(c, {"contacts": bad})
        raise SystemExit("expected ValueError")
    except ValueError:
        pass
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Al"), ("x@y.z", "X")]
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
for env in ([], {}, {"contacts": "x"}, {"contacts": [], "z": 1}):
    try:
        handle_import(c, env)
        raise SystemExit("expected ValueError")
    except ValueError:
        pass
